title: Bridge verified-versions metadata (v1 — locked in v0.6.0)
description: Project-owned audit artifact recording which exact upstream versions a bridge release was verified against. Lives at .specify/extensions/speckit-superpowers-bridge/verified-versions.json. Five-field locked schema; future releases MAY add keys (additive) but MUST NOT remove or rename existing keys or change their value types.

verified_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp ending in 'Z'. Generated by the release runbook at the moment of verified-pair lock-in.

spec_kit_version.description: Exact Spec Kit version (no leading 'v') that this bridge release was tested against. Example: '0.8.16'.

superpowers_version.description: Exact Superpowers version (no leading 'v') that this bridge release was tested against. Example: '5.1.0'.

bridge_version.description: Bridge release this verified-pair belongs to. MUST equal extension.yml.extension.version AND marketplace/catalog-entry.json.version. Example: '0.6.0'.

notes.description: Free-text upstream caveats relevant to this verified pair. May be empty string. Multi-line allowed via standard JSON string-escape rules. CHANGELOG carries structured upstream-change details; this is a short pointer.

examples.notes: Superpowers v5.1.0 removed deprecated /brainstorm /execute-plan /write-plan slash commands and the superpowers:code-reviewer named agent; bridge surface is grepped clean (no remediation). finishing-a-development-branch now only cleans .worktrees/ — transparent. Spec Kit v0.8.16 changes are transparent to bridge consumers.
